  cases xs
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs' ih => 
    unfold interleave at *
    generalize (interleave ys xs').length = _ as h
    have := ih ys
    rw [this, add_comm]
    <;> linarith

def interleave : List α → List α → List α := 
  fun xs ys => match xs, ys with
    | [], ys => ys
    | x :: xs', ys => x :: interleave ys xs'
termination_by xs ys => xs.length + ys.length

theorem length_interleave (xs ys : List α) :
  (interleave xs ys).length = xs.length + ys.length := by
  cases xs with
  | nil => simp [interleave]
  | cons x xs' ih => 
    unfold interleave
    have := ih ys
    rw [this, add_assoc]

def interleave : List α → List α → List α := 
  fun xs ys => match xs, ys with
    | [], ys => ys
    | x :: xs', ys => x :: interleave ys xs'
termination_by xs ys => xs.length + ys.length

theorem length_interleave (xs ys : List α) :
  (interleave xs ys).length = xs.length + ys.length := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => simp [interleave]
  | cons x xs ih => 
    unfold interleave at *
    have hih := ih ys
    rw [hih, add_assoc]
